newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian investment tax reforms by Sept 97 -govt.
newsitem.headline: Italian investment tax reforms by Sept 97 -govt.

text.p: New proposals governing a reform of tax on investments should come into force by September 1997, the finance ministry said in a draft law released on Monday, which has been attached to the 1997 budget bill.
The draft proposals recommend that the current withholding tax for residents on state bonds and bills should remain fixed at 12.5 percent.

Three tax levels for additional investment income would be introduced, with the minimum rate set at 12.5 percent and the maximum at 27 percent, "favouring long-term instruments traded on regulated markets or in public offers."
The third, mid-level rate has yet to be fixed.
The finance ministry document also recommended tax breaks lasting up to three years for newly listed companies.
